jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description: Area Sales Manager – New Business & Business Development Location: Birmingham/Coventry & Surrounding Salary: £35-38k basic salary + highly competitive commission structure (OTE circa £55-65k) Package: Excellent company benefits including Company Car, Pension, Life Cover, & many more. Are you a proven B2B sales professional who genuinely enjoys winning new business? We’re looking for an Area Sales Manager to take ownership of a defined territory and drive growth through a predominantly new-business-focused sales role. You’ll be responsible for introducing our clients comprehensive maintenance and service solution for the upkeep/repair of capital equipment that is crucial to the smooth and successful running of their operations. These organisations will be those where reliability, service and long-term partnership really matter. Your target market will include hospitals and healthcare organisations, care homes, universities, schools, prisons and selected hotel groups. While there is an expectation for you to self generate some of your new leads, you will also have the robust support of an internal team who will identify, qualify and pass potential new opportunities for you to investigate and convert, and the majority of your meetings will be pre-booked for you, leaving you time to complete various admin tasks, follow up on quotes submitted and close business! This is a role for someone who enjoys the hunt – identifying opportunities, opening doors, building relationships with decision-makers and ultimately winning the business. Once you’ve won a customer, you’ll retain responsibility for that relationship, with the role gradually developing to include more account management, retention and growth. However, new business will always remain a significant part of the role, so a genuine appetite for winning new customers is essential. The role You’ll be expected to: Identify and follow up on new business opportunities across your territory Build relationships with decision-makers across healthcare, education, public sector, care and hospitality Proactively prospect and generate your own opportunities as well as inbound leads Manage the full sales cycle, from initial contact through to negotiation and close Understand customer challenges and position a solution around their needs Navigate complex organisations and multiple stakeholders Win new contracts and develop those relationships over the long term Take increasing responsibility for account management, retention and further growth Identify opportunities to expand relationships within existing customers Manage your own diary, territory and pipeline with a high degree of autonomy Consistently deliver against ambitious new-business and revenue targets What we’re looking for This role will suit someone who has a proven and consistent track record in B2B field sales, particularly someone who has demonstrated the ability to build a territory and deliver new-business growth over a sustained period. You’ll need to be a hunter by nature. Someone who enjoys prospecting, isn’t afraid to pick up the phone, can open doors and gets genuine satisfaction from turning a cold opportunity into a new customer. You’ll also need to demonstrate an understanding that winning the customer is only the beginning. You’ll be responsible for building a relationship that lasts, understanding the customer’s operation and identifying opportunities to grow the account over time. We’re particularly interested in people who can demonstrate: A strong track record of B2B new-business sales Consistent performance and progression throughout their career The resilience and determination required to operate in a target-driven environment Experience selling maintenance/service solutions or services Having sold capex into one of the previously mentioned routes to market would also be a great fit, especially if there is the opportunity to sell a service or maintenance contract alongside The ability to sell into complex or multi-stakeholder organisations Strong commercial awareness and negotiation skills Excellent relationship-building and communication skills The ability to operate autonomously and manage a territory effectively A genuine desire to win new business – you should enjoy the chase A stable career history and evidence of building long-term relationships with customers and employers What is on offer Basic Salary – £35k-£38k DOE + competitive commission structure (OTE circa £55-£65k) Company Car – EV options only Life insurance, Company Pension & Access to a Well-Being app which gives you access to dental care & similar 25 days holiday + Bank Holidays

Non-Residential Specification Sales Manager The Role: The Specification Sales Manager role is working for an instantly recognisable brand within the sanitaryware & bathroom product manufacturing sector. You will be covering an area across the East Anglia, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, and Northern Home Counties. Put a high-quality portfolio of professional bean-to-cup machines in front of regional & national coffee chains, hotel groups, restaurants and major contract caterers. Highly competitive package including life assurance & enhance, non-contributory pension! Business Development Manager – Commercial Coffee Equipment Package: £60-70,000 basic salary + bonus, car allowance or company car options, life assurance, enhanced company pension. UK | Field-Based This is a fantastic new-business opportunity for a proven capital equipment sales professional looking to make their mark within a company, setting the standard in new business acquisition. We’re looking for an ambitious and commercially driven New Business Development Manager to join a leading professional coffee equipment business to take responsibility for winning new customers across the UK. This is an out-and-out new business role where you will focus purely on identifying prospects, opening doors, developing relationships and winning new accounts before handing them over to the wider team. You’ll be selling a market-leading portfolio of professional bean-to-cup coffee machines, working with some of the UK’s most exciting and established hospitality and foodservice businesses. Who you’ll be targeting… Your focus will be on winning new business across: Regional and national coffee shop chains Hotels and hotel groups Restaurants and restaurant groups Contract caterers Other large-scale hospitality and foodservice operators You’ll engage with senior commercial, procurement, operations and hospitality decision-makers, understanding their requirements and presenting the right coffee solution for their business. What you’ll be doing… This is a true hunter position. You’ll be responsible for the complete new-business sales process from prospecting through to winning the account. You’ll: Identify and target new business opportunities across your territory. Build a pipeline of high-value prospects from scratch. Develop relationships with key decision-makers across hospitality and foodservice. Arrange and lead customer meetings, demonstrations and presentations. Understand customer requirements and develop compelling commercial proposals. Manage complex capital equipment sales cycles through to close. Negotiate commercial terms and secure new contracts. Win new customers and successfully hand them over to the relevant account/delivery teams. Consistently develop new opportunities rather than managing an inherited account base. Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting and activity records. What we’re looking for… We’re looking for a proven new-business field sales professional who enjoys hunting for opportunities and winning customers. Ideally, you’ll have: A strong track record in new-business field sales. Previous experience selling capital equipment. Experience selling into coffee shops, hotels, restaurants, contract caterers or wider hospitality/foodservice environments. The confidence to engage with senior decision-makers and build relationships from cold. Experience managing longer, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Strong commercial awareness and negotiation skills. A highly proactive, self-motivated approach. A genuine hunter mentality – you’re motivated by opening doors and winning new logos. Why this opportunity? This is an opportunity to represent a premium portfolio of professional bean-to-cup coffee machines in a market where businesses are increasingly looking for quality, consistency, efficiency and scalable coffee solutions. You’ll have the opportunity to engage with major hospitality and foodservice operators and play a direct role in growing the business through new customer acquisition. If you’re the type of salesperson who gets excited by finding a prospect, opening the door, winning the opportunity and moving on to the next one, this could be a very good fit. The Package… Basic Salary £60-70,000 plus competitive commission structure Car Allowance or Company Car Life Assurance, Enhanced non-contributory Company Pension 25 days holiday + Bank Holidays, Birthday Off
